title: National Diet Building
scope: The National Diet Building in Nagatachō, including the central limestone-toned granite tower, both chamber wings, their four courtyards, and front entry porticoes.
limitations: Façade and tower trim are reconstructed from the public-domain views, documented heights, and the mapped footprint.
Windows on service elevations and roof service elements are approximate.
Scope includes the main Diet Building, its open courts and immediate entry stairs. Detached office blocks are outside the structure envelope.
